--- from_subquery_in.sql
SELECT 1 IN (FROM UNNEST([1]))

            ValueEnd: 8,

          Right: &ast.SubQueryInCondition{
            Lparen: 12,
            Rparen: 29,
            Query:  &ast.FromQuery{
              From: &ast.From{
                From:   13,
                Source: &ast.Unnest{
                  Unnest: 18,
                  Rparen: 28,
                  Expr:   &ast.ArrayLiteral{
                    Array:  -1,
                    Lbrack: 25,
                    Rbrack: 27,
                    Values: []ast.Expr{
                      &ast.IntLiteral{
                        ValuePos: 26,
                        ValueEnd: 27,
                        Base:     10,
                        Value:    "1",
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}
